description: Guidance for using TencentDB Agent Memory concepts to structure, retrieve, govern, and reuse agent memory across tasks and projects.

defaultPrompt: Help me design a layered memory workflow for this project using TencentDB Agent Memory concepts.
Turn this completed task into a reusable skill or scenario memory, preserving evidence and caveats.
Review a proposed agent-memory setup for retrieval quality, access control, and privacy risks.
interface.longDescription: A workflow companion for TencentDB Agent Memory. Helps plan layered memory, organize reusable skills and knowledge, reason about retrieval, and check access boundaries. This package provides guidance; it does not deploy or connect to a TencentDB Agent Memory server by itself.

name: tencentdb-agent-memory
